fr_eveque_noun.why: EGLISE2b fix (Nov 1 2026): the old vacuum hook clashed with aspirer (the vacuuming mime in eglise/saints), so évêque gets its own picture: the bishop holding up a giant carrot. cathedrale.jpg and the credence zoom edited to match.
